# jira-reader

## Purpose
Fetch Jira ticket data via MCP

## Instructions
- Call MCP: get_jira_ticket(ticket_ids)
- Extract:
  - title
  - description
  - acceptance criteria

## Output
{
  "tickets": [
    {
      "id": "",
      "title": "",
      "description": "",
      "acceptance_criteria": []
    }
  ]
}
